captures.notes: Fourteen connected parcels form a third distinct footprint with varied base and roof bands. Visible public tops are authored light boards and every inhabited stack is capped.
The reverse overview shows compact overlapping levels and a readable outer silhouette; there is no broad central lawn or top-to-ground shaft.
The exposed section contains only tower, narrow/deep, and multi-storey square parcels. Roof gables align with their runs and unrelated buildings do not intersect.
The public landing feeds a turning stocked market route between facades. The far edge is occluded by actual construction rather than a freestanding prop.
At player height the reverse corridor is broken by bends, facade mass, and changes in public elevation; it cannot be read as a straight street across the settlement.
The cross view has building walls and an upper crossing bounding exterior circulation while retaining usable headroom.
This seed needs only four infill patches because parcel and route mass close more of the volume. Those patches remain connected, planked, guarded, and aligned to addressed entrances.
The occupied link reads as a roofed building connection, not a bare floating deck, and both endpoint seams are closed.
The underside shows legitimate exterior passage below inhabited construction with no dark render skin appearing on the walkable upper face.
All visible room stacks, the selected outcropping, and occupied links have pitched closure; roof repeats tile without an uncovered room rectangle.
The top-down route and construction signatures differ from seeds 0 and 1. Four disjoint guarded wells retain downward glimpses without merging into an open core.
